sentences.en: So, Kim, you've learned that Alex grows up occupying this kind of in-between space when it comes to race.
sentences.zh: 那么，金，你了解到亚历克斯在成长过程中，在种族认同方面一直处于一种中间地带。

sentences.en: Raised by his white mother with his Black siblings and friends thinking he doesn't quite understand the world the way they do.
sentences.zh: 他由白人母亲抚养长大，而他的黑人兄弟姐妹和朋友们却认为他并不像他们那样真正理解这个世界。

sentences.en: Tell us how this leads to his path toward being a police officer.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们，这如何让他走上了成为一名警察的道路。

sentences.en: So, meanwhile, Alex is thinking about what he wants to do with his life and what he wants to be when he grows up.
sentences.zh: 当时，亚历克斯正在思考自己的人生规划，以及长大后想成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: And in high school, he just sort of is flirting with the idea of maybe becoming a police officer.
sentences.zh: 在高中时，他只是偶尔闪过想当警察的念头。

sentences.en: But what he really wanted to do is become a soccer player, a professional soccer player.
sentences.zh: 但他真正想做的是成为一名足球运动员，一名职业足球运动员。

sentences.en: So, he had mentioned the idea of becoming a police officer, but it was nothing like that he was really driven towards.
sentences.zh: 所以，他虽然提过想当警察，但这并不是他真正渴望追求的目标。

sentences.en: In fact, he graduates from high school and he decides to go very far away from home for the first time and move to the Bronx and enroll in a college there and try to
sentences.zh: 事实上，他高中毕业后决定第一次远离家乡，搬到布朗克斯，进入当地的一所大学，并试图

sentences.en: be on the soccer team.
sentences.zh: 加入足球队。

sentences.en: And it just doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 但结果并不顺利。

sentences.en: He had blown out his ACLs, I think both ACLs, and had surgery.
sentences.zh: 他的前十字韧带撕裂了，我想是两条都断了，还做了手术。

sentences.en: And he just wasn't able to be the soccer player that he once was.
sentences.zh: 他再也无法成为曾经那个优秀的足球运动员了。

sentences.en: And he doesn't know what he wants to do with his life as well.
sentences.zh: 而且他对自己的人生方向也感到迷茫。

sentences.en: So, he packs up and he moves back home to Minneapolis and back home with his mom.
sentences.zh: 于是，他收拾行囊搬回了明尼阿波利斯的家中，回到了母亲身边。

sentences.en: And he starts going to the University of Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 他开始在明尼苏达大学就读。

sentences.en: And at the same time, he starts working a part-time job at Macy's, looking for shoplifters and working as kind of a security guard.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他在梅西百货找了一份兼职，负责抓捕商店扒手，干着类似保安的工作。

sentences.en: And meets like some police officers and former police officers who tell him, hey, this could be a great career for you.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他遇到了一些现任和前任警察，他们告诉他，嘿，这会是一份很适合你的职业。

sentences.en: You'd be a natural fit.
sentences.zh: 你天生就是干这行的料。

sentences.en: And he starts thinking much more seriously about the idea of becoming a police officer.
sentences.zh: 于是，他开始认真考虑成为一名警察的想法。

sentences.en: And keep in mind, this is in Minneapolis, a place that has been basically like ground zero for
sentences.zh: 请记住，这发生在明尼阿波利斯，这里基本上是全国

sentences.en: Black Lives Matter protests nationally.
sentences.zh: “黑人的命也是命”抗议活动的震中。

sentences.en: You know, you had Philando Castile, you had Jamar Clark, you have all these incidents that really have roiled people up and the movement up nationally happening in
sentences.zh: 你知道，当时发生了菲兰多·卡斯蒂尔案、贾马尔·克拉克案，所有这些事件都在明尼阿波利斯发生，

sentences.en: Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 并激怒了全国民众和运动参与者。

sentences.en: And this is when he's deciding to become a police officer.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他决定成为警察的时候。

sentences.en: And this doesn't sit well with some people, especially Darrow, his good friend growing up.
sentences.zh: 这让一些人感到不舒服，尤其是他从小到大的好朋友达罗。

sentences.en: And Darrow's out on the street, he's protesting.
sentences.zh: 达罗当时正在街头参加抗议活动。

sentences.en: And, you know, they start having these conversations where Darrow's like, you cannot become a police officer, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们开始进行这些对话，达罗说，你不能去当警察，你知道的。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, Alex is saying, yes, I can.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，亚历克斯却说，不，我可以。

sentences.en: I want to become a police officer and I want to change the force from the inside and I want to make it better.
sentences.zh: 我想成为一名警察，我想从内部改变警队，我想让它变得更好。

sentences.en: You know, I want to make it sort of a kinder, gentler police force, one that will treat my siblings and my friends with respect.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想让它成为一支更友善、更温和的警队，一支能尊重我的兄弟姐妹和朋友的警队。

sentences.en: And Darrow's saying, you cannot change the police force from the inside.
sentences.zh: 而达罗则说，你无法从内部改变警队。

sentences.en: The police force will change you.
sentences.zh: 警队会改变你。

sentences.en: But despite the concerns of his friends and some of his family members, Alex does join the police academy.
sentences.zh: 但尽管朋友和一些家人的担忧，亚历克斯还是加入了警察学院。

sentences.en: And this causes a rift in their friendship, the friendship between Darrow and Alex.
sentences.zh: 这导致了他们友谊的破裂，达罗和亚历克斯之间的友谊出现了裂痕。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't think it was ever like spoken like this is why we have a rift.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不认为他们曾明确说过这就是我们产生隔阂的原因。

sentences.en: But Darrow went from talking to Alex very, very regularly and seeing him often to just talking on the phone.
sentences.zh: 但达罗从以前经常和亚历克斯交谈、频繁见面，变成了只在电话里联系。

sentences.en: And when Darrow had a negative interaction with the police, he didn't even tell his friend Alex about it, even though Alex was in the academy.
sentences.zh: 当达罗与警察发生不愉快的冲突时，他甚至没有告诉身为警察学院学员的好友亚历克斯。

sentences.en: And what was the experience?
sentences.zh: 那次经历是什么样的？

sentences.en: So in August of 2019, Darrow was riding his bike home from work.
sentences.zh: 2019年8月，达罗下班骑自行车回家。

sentences.en: He worked as a bike mechanic and he drove by these two police squad cars that were parked right next to each other, sort of blocking part of the road.
sentences.zh: 他是一名自行车修理工，当时他骑车经过两辆并排停放的警车，它们挡住了部分道路。

sentences.en: And I'm a bicycliSt. I can't stand like when people are blocking the bike lane.
sentences.zh: 我本人也是骑行者，我最讨厌别人占用自行车道。

sentences.en: It's really annoying and it's very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 这真的很烦人，而且非常危险。

sentences.en: And so he sees these two police cars doing it parked side by side and he yells at them that they're blocking the road.
sentences.zh: 所以他看到那两辆警车并排停在那里，就冲他们大喊，说他们挡路了。

sentences.en: And the police then follow him and demand that he dump out his bicycle bag on the ground and then made him pick up the contents.
sentences.zh: 随后警察追上他，要求他把自行车包里的东西倒在地上，并强迫他把东西捡起来。

sentences.en: And he felt very humiliated by this.
sentences.zh: 他感到非常屈辱。

sentences.en: And he also felt like harassed, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且他还感到被骚扰了，你知道的。

sentences.en: And he didn't even tell Alex about that.
sentences.zh: 他甚至没把这件事告诉亚历克斯。

sentences.en: He just felt like Alex was too far gone and that he wouldn't understand and that he would take the side of police.
sentences.zh: 他只是觉得亚历克斯已经走得太远了，他不会理解，而且会站在警察那一边。

sentences.en: And around the same time, there's another interaction that happens between law enforcement and somebody close to Alex.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，执法部门与亚历克斯身边的人又发生了另一次冲突。

sentences.en: This time it's his sibling, Taylor, and he does find out about what happened.
sentences.zh: 这次是他的兄弟泰勒，而他确实得知了发生的事情。

sentences.en: Taylor and a friend were in downtown Minneapolis and they observed sheriff's deputies interrogating and moving to arrest a couple of homeless guys who were allegedly publicly
sentences.zh: 泰勒和一个朋友在明尼阿波利斯市中心，他们看到治安官副手正在盘问并准备逮捕两名据称在公共场合

sentences.en: intoxicated.
sentences.zh: 醉酒的流浪汉。

sentences.en: So they move up there.
sentences.zh: 于是他们走了过去。

sentences.en: Taylor starts videoing the interaction.
sentences.zh: 泰勒开始拍摄这一过程。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: And Taylor's friend starts, you know, saying, what are you doing and trying to intervene?
sentences.zh: 泰勒的朋友开始说，你们在干什么，并试图进行干预。

sentences.en: And the sheriff's deputies pretty aggressively throw Taylor's friend to the ground.
sentences.zh: 治安官副手非常粗暴地将泰勒的朋友按倒在地。

sentences.en: And arrest the friend, arrest Taylor and the sheriff's deputies actually book the two and charge them and take them to the jail.
sentences.zh: 并逮捕了那个朋友，也逮捕了泰勒，治安官副手实际上对两人进行了登记、指控，并将他们带到了监狱。

sentences.en: And from the jail, the first person Taylor calls is Alex, who gets Taylor out of jail and sees the video and says that what these sheriff's deputies did was wrong and says that
sentences.zh: 在监狱里，泰勒打给的第一个人就是亚历克斯，亚历克斯把泰勒保释出来，看了视频后说治安官副手的做法是错误的，并表示

sentences.en: this is not the way that the police and sheriff's deputies should conduct themselves, but makes a distinction that this is the sheriff's office.
sentences.zh: 这不是警察和治安官副手应有的行为方式，但他做出了区分，说这是治安官办公室的问题。

sentences.en: I'm becoming a Minneapolis police officer.
sentences.zh: 我即将成为明尼阿波利斯警察。

sentences.en: We do things differently.
sentences.zh: 我们的行事方式不同。

sentences.en: And this is the exactly the kind of scenario that I want to stop.
sentences.zh: 这正是我想阻止的那种情况。

sentences.en: This is not the sort of police officer that I am going to be.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会成为那种警察。

sentences.en: So all around Alex King, faith in policing is sort of collapsing.
sentences.zh: 所以，亚历克斯·金周围的人对警务工作的信任正在崩塌。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, he is in police training.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他正在接受警察培训。

sentences.en: How does that go?
sentences.zh: 进展如何？

sentences.en: So he has to go to a police academy and a police academy is where new recruits and cadets are taught the basics of being a modern police officer.
sentences.zh: 他必须进入警察学院，警察学院是新招募的学员学习现代警察基本技能的地方。

sentences.en: And this includes a lot of, you know, the most modern policing techniques.
sentences.zh: 这包括很多，你知道的，最现代的警务技术。

sentences.en: It's going to include de-escalation.
sentences.zh: 它会包括冲突降级。

sentences.en: It's going to include how do you deal with a mentally ill person that you're responding to?
sentences.zh: 它会包括当你面对精神病患者时该如何处理？

sentences.en: How do you use a taser?
sentences.zh: 如何使用泰瑟枪？

sentences.en: All these sort of things.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情。

sentences.en: This is where you're allegedly supposed to be learning how to be a cop.
sentences.zh: 这就是你应该学习如何成为一名警察的地方。

sentences.en: But what I found is the real training takes place after the police academy.
sentences.zh: 但我发现真正的培训是在警察学院之后进行的。

sentences.en: When a new recruit like Alex is assigned a field training officer or FTO.
sentences.zh: 当像亚历克斯这样的新兵被分配给一名现场培训官（FTO）时。

sentences.en: And like most large police departments across the country use this model.
sentences.zh: 全国大多数大型警察局都采用这种模式。

sentences.en: And the idea is that you partner a brand new cop up with a field training officer or FTO who sort of works with them every
sentences.zh: 其理念是让你与一名现场培训官（FTO）搭档，他每天都和你一起工作，

sentences.en: single day, who grades their performance, who talks to them, who says, this is what you did well.
sentences.zh: 评估你的表现，和你交谈，告诉你，这是你做得好的地方。

sentences.en: This is what you did wrong on that particular call.
sentences.zh: 这是你在那次出警中做得不对的地方。

sentences.en: Shows them the ropes.
sentences.zh: 教他们门道。

sentences.en: Shows them the ropes.
sentences.zh: 教他们门道。

sentences.en: And in the very beginning, the various sort of recruits that I talked to, you're basically told your FTO is
sentences.zh: 起初，我采访过的各种学员都被告知，你的FTO就是

sentences.en: God.
sentences.zh: 上帝。

sentences.en: Forget everything you've learned in the academy.
sentences.zh: 忘掉你在学院里学到的一切。

sentences.en: Your FTO is God.
sentences.zh: 你的FTO就是上帝。

sentences.en: And this FTO single-handedly has the ability to say whether you're going to become a police officer or not.
sentences.zh: 这位FTO拥有单方面决定你是否能成为一名警察的权力。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: They can say you've washed out.
sentences.zh: 他们可以说你被淘汰了。

sentences.en: And in fact, I talked to two people who did wash out at this particular stage in Minneapolis, who both were told that they weren't aggressive enough.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我采访过两个在明尼阿波利斯这个阶段被淘汰的人，他们都被告知自己不够激进。

sentences.en: That they didn't seem like they would resort to force quickly enough.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来不像会那么快诉诸武力。

sentences.en: That's really interesting as a reporter, hearing those kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 作为一名记者，听到这些事情真的很有趣。

sentences.en: That like this idea that you can go through with the academy and the academy can teach you all these different, the most modern sort of policing techniques.
sentences.zh: 这种想法是，你可以通过学院的培训，学院可以教你所有这些不同的、最现代的警务技术。

sentences.en: This is how you de-escalate.
sentences.zh: 这是如何进行冲突降级。

sentences.en: This is how you deal with a mentally ill person.
sentences.zh: 这是如何处理精神病患者。

sentences.en: But then you get to the police force and there is this one person who can say whether you're going to actually become a police officer or not.
sentences.zh: 但当你进入警队后，却有这么一个人可以决定你是否真的能成为一名警察。

sentences.en: And for Alex King, his main FTO was Derek
sentences.zh: 对于亚历克斯·金来说，他的主要FTO是德里克·

sentences.en: Chauvin.
sentences.zh: 肖万。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And what did you learn about that relationship?
sentences.zh: 你对这段关系有什么了解？

sentences.en: Well, what I was told is that new recruits have usually three rounds of FTO training, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我被告知新兵通常有三轮FTO培训，对吧？

sentences.en: And they typically move around to different precincts and work with different FTOs.
sentences.zh: 他们通常会轮换到不同的辖区，与不同的FTO合作。

sentences.en: But King ended up getting Derek Chauvin as his FTO most of the time.
sentences.zh: 但金最终大部分时间都是由德里克·肖万担任他的FTO。

sentences.en: He ended up getting Derek Chauvin twice.
sentences.zh: 他最终两次由德里克·肖万带教。

sentences.en: So more than usual.
sentences.zh: 所以比通常情况要多。

sentences.en: More than usual.
sentences.zh: 比通常情况要多。

sentences.en: We also learned from Alex's mother that at one time, Alex called her quite upset about an interaction he had had with his FTO.
sentences.zh: 我们还从亚历克斯的母亲那里得知，有一次，亚历克斯打电话给她，因为与他的FTO的一次互动而感到非常不安。

sentences.en: What Alex described was doing something that displeased his
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯描述说，他做了一些让他的

sentences.en: FTO and being dressed down and being very worried about what that was going to mean.
sentences.zh: FTO不高兴的事情，结果被训斥了一顿，他非常担心这会意味着什么。

sentences.en: We also learned that Derek Chauvin actually did exercise his authority over when and if Alex King would become a police officer by delaying the end of his training.
sentences.zh: 我们还了解到，德里克·肖万确实行使了他的权力，通过推迟亚历克斯·金的培训结束时间，来决定他何时以及能否成为一名警察。

sentences.en: And the reason he did that was because he felt like Alex King was responding to too many calls with another rookie.
sentences.zh: 他这样做的原因是，他觉得亚历克斯·金和另一名新兵一起处理了太多的报警电话。

sentences.en: Now, we don't know for certain why that's a problem, but through other reporting I've done on the police, sometimes you're partnered with somebody else if you're an officer.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们不确定为什么这会是个问题，但通过我之前对警方的报道，有时如果你是警察，你会和别人搭档。

sentences.en: Sometimes you're riding along solo and you've got to respond to calls on your own.
sentences.zh: 有时你会独自巡逻，必须自己处理报警电话。

sentences.en: And it could be that Chauvin felt like Alex King and the other rookie were not showing enough initiative to respond to calls on their own, right?
sentences.zh: 可能是肖万觉得亚历克斯·金和另一名新兵没有表现出足够的积极性去独立处理报警电话，对吧？

sentences.en: But the other rookie who also got his probation extended and had to wait before becoming a full-fledged
sentences.zh: 但另一名同样被延长了试用期，在成为正式警察之前必须等待的

sentences.en: officer was Thomas Lane, who was obviously the same officer that King was partnered with the day that they
sentences.zh: 新兵是托马斯·莱恩，他显然就是金在响应那起有人在便利店使用20美元假钞的报警电话时，与他搭档的那位警察。

sentences.en: responded to a call that somebody had used a counterfeit $20 bill at a corner store.
sentences.zh: 而那个人，当然就是乔治·弗洛伊德。

sentences.en: And that, of course, was George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 而那个现场，肖万很快就会作为高级警官赶到。

sentences.en: And that scene was one that Chauvin would soon arrive at as the senior officer.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 金当时是他作为警察的第三个正式工作日，而莱恩是第四个。

sentences.en: And King was on his third official day as an officer and Lane was on his fourth.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在带我们重温一下那个场景，那个在德里克·肖万跪在乔治·弗洛伊德脖子上那近九分钟的时间里，大家非常熟悉的场景。

sentences.en: Well, take us through that scene now, that scene that is so familiar when it comes to those almost nine minutes when Derek Chauvin is kneeling on George Floyd's neck.
sentences.zh: 带我们看看它在金和莱恩面前是如何展开的。

sentences.en: But take us through it as it unfolds for King and Lane.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，莱恩和金接到报告说，一家商店有人使用了20美元的假钞，于是他们赶到了现场。

sentences.en: So Lane and King show up that evening on a report that a $20 counterfeit bill had been used at a store.
sentences.zh: 他们到达后进入店内，发现嫌疑人正坐在外面的车里。

sentences.en: They show up and they go inside and they, you know, find out that the guy who's suspected of doing so is sitting outside in a car.
sentences.zh: 伙计，你知道我们为什么在这儿吗？

sentences.en: Man, do you know why we're here?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 我们在这儿是因为听起来你给了里面的人一张假钞。

sentences.en: We're here because it sounds like you gave a fake bill to the individuals in there.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 你明白吗？

sentences.en: You understand that?
sentences.zh: 明白。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 你知道我们为什么把你从车里带出来吗？

sentences.en: And do you know why we pulled you out of the car?
sentences.zh: 因为你根本不听我们说的任何话。

sentences.en: Because you was not listening to anything we told you.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: I didn't know what was going on.
sentences.zh: 你听我们的，我们会告诉你发生了什么。

sentences.en: You listened to us and we will tell you what's going on.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 当你那样乱动时，这让我们觉得事情比我们知道的要复杂得多。

sentences.en: When you're moving around like that, that makes us think way more is going on than we need to know.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 那不是我的情况。

sentences.en: And that's not what I have.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 我们要把你放进警车的后座。

sentences.en: We're going to put you in the back of a squad.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 我们会把这一切处理清楚的。

sentences.en: We're going to sort all this out.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 于是他们把他拉出来，处理了很长一段时间，几分钟。

sentences.en: And so they pull him out and they deal with him for quite a while, several minutes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And George Floyd is obviously under some distress.
sentences.zh: 乔治·弗洛伊德显然处于某种痛苦之中。

sentences.en: He talks about already how he was having a hard time breathing.
sentences.zh: 他已经在说自己呼吸困难了。

sentences.en: He talks about his issues with the police.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了自己与警察之间的问题。

sentences.en: He says he doesn't want to, you know, be arrested.
sentences.zh: 他说他不想，你知道，被逮捕。

sentences.en: And they're trying to put him in the back of the car.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图把他塞进车后座。

sentences.en: And he's not going.
sentences.zh: 但他不肯进去。

sentences.en: That is when Derek Chauvin and two Tau show up.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，德里克·肖万和两名陶警官出现了。

sentences.en: Chauvin immediately takes over.
sentences.zh: 肖万立即接管了现场。

sentences.en: And it's pretty quick that there is a takedown of Floyd.
sentences.zh: 很快，弗洛伊德就被制服了。

sentences.en: He will not get in the back of the car.
sentences.zh: 他就是不肯进车后座。

sentences.en: And so Chauvin and the other officers get Floyd on his stomach.
sentences.zh: 于是肖万和其他警官把弗洛伊德按在地上，脸朝下。

sentences.en: And Chauvin proceeds to put his knee near the back of Floyd's neck.
sentences.zh: 肖万接着把膝盖抵在弗洛伊德的脖子后面。

sentences.en: We've all seen this image, right?
sentences.zh: 我们都见过这张照片，对吧？

sentences.en: But to look at it from the perspective of the other officers on the scene, you've got Tau, who's very much doing crowd control.
sentences.zh: 但从现场其他警官的角度来看，陶警官当时主要在进行人群控制。

sentences.en: And he's not really involved with what's happening with Floyd at this time.
sentences.zh: 他当时并没有真正参与到弗洛伊德身上发生的事情中。

sentences.en: He's just dealing with everybody who's crowding around and saying, like, the man has said he cannot breathe.
sentences.zh: 他只是在应付周围围观的人，并说，你看，这个人已经说他无法呼吸了。

sentences.en: Get off his back.
sentences.zh: 从他背上下来。

sentences.en: You've got Alex King, who's controlling, like, the midsection of Floyd, sort of like on his back, making sure that he's not moving around.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·金当时在控制弗洛伊德的中段，也就是背部位置，确保他不会乱动。

sentences.en: And you've got Lane, who's on his feet.
sentences.zh: 还有莱恩，他站在旁边。

sentences.en: And, you know, you've got a man who's lying face down, who's continually saying he cannot breathe, who's saying, please.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那个人脸朝下躺着，一直在说他无法呼吸，一直在求救。

sentences.en: He was calling for his mother, calling mama.
sentences.zh: 他在呼唤他的母亲，喊着妈妈。

sentences.en: And pretty soon he's not saying anything.
sentences.zh: 很快，他就什么声音都没有了。

sentences.en: At no point does Alex King ever question Derek Chauvin.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·金自始至终都没有质疑过德里克·肖万。

sentences.en: He doesn't ask him if this is okay, what is happening.
sentences.zh: 他没有问他这样做是否妥当，也没有问到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: He doesn't suggest, like Lane does, that they turn George Floyd over on his side.
sentences.zh: 他不像莱恩那样建议把乔治·弗洛伊德翻过来侧卧。

sentences.en: King does not challenge Derek Chauvin.
sentences.zh: 金没有挑战德里克·肖万。

sentences.en: The only thing that he does is help hold down George Floyd and tell Chauvin that George Floyd has no pulse.
sentences.zh: 他唯一做的事就是帮忙按住乔治·弗洛伊德，并告诉肖万乔治·弗洛伊德已经没有脉搏了。

sentences.en: And that is it.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: And then, you know, these officers are all arrested.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，这些警察都被逮捕了。

sentences.en: Daryl Jones talked to Alex King the next night.
sentences.zh: 达里尔·琼斯第二天晚上和亚历克斯·金谈过。

sentences.en: They talked for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他们谈了很久。

sentences.en: Daryl will not say what they talked about.
sentences.zh: 达里尔不愿透露他们谈了什么。

sentences.en: It was a private conversation, but he cries every time he brings it up.
sentences.zh: 那是一次私人谈话，但他每次提起时都会哭。

sentences.en: And Daryl, he went to the protest after George Floyd's death, but he couldn't find it in himself to actually participate.
sentences.zh: 达里尔在乔治·弗洛伊德去世后参加了抗议活动，但他发现自己无法真正投入其中。

sentences.en: Because he's so conflicted.
sentences.zh: 因为他内心非常矛盾。

sentences.en: Because his friend is one of the cops who's accused of murder.
sentences.zh: 因为他的朋友是被指控谋杀的警察之一。

sentences.en: Well, aiding and abetting, yes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，协助和教唆，是的。

sentences.en: At least two of Alex's siblings were less conflicted.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯至少有两个兄弟姐妹没那么矛盾。

sentences.en: Radiance and Taylor both participated in the protests that followed George Floyd's death.
sentences.zh: 雷迪恩斯和泰勒都参加了乔治·弗洛伊德去世后的抗议活动。

sentences.en: Radiance also said that as a black man, he should have known better and he should have intervened.
sentences.zh: 雷迪恩斯还说，作为一个黑人，他本应该更清楚，他本应该进行干预。

sentences.en: And she said that she planned to change her last name because she did not want to be associated with her brother's actions.
sentences.zh: 她说她打算改掉自己的姓氏，因为她不想与她哥哥的行为扯上关系。

sentences.en: So, please introduce yourself.
sentences.zh: 那么，请自我介绍一下。

sentences.en: I'm Taylor.
sentences.zh: 我是泰勒。

sentences.en: Taylor King.
sentences.zh: 泰勒·金。

sentences.en: Taylor appeared in a press conference with the head of the local NAACP chapter to talk about what happened that night with George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 泰勒与当地全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）负责人一起出席了新闻发布会，谈论了那天晚上乔治·弗洛伊德身上发生的事情。

sentences.en: I am the sibling of one of the four officers involved in the murder of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 我是参与谋杀乔治·弗洛伊德的四名警官之一的兄弟姐妹。

sentences.en: Our pronouns are they, them, I am non-binary.
sentences.zh: 我的代词是“他们”，我是非二元性别者。

sentences.en: Taylor acknowledged being related to Alex, but never mentioned him by name.
sentences.zh: 泰勒承认与亚历克斯有亲属关系，但从未直呼其名。

sentences.en: And Taylor also acknowledged their own history with the sheriff's department and mentioned that taped encounter from 2019 and what it felt like.
sentences.zh: 泰勒还承认了自己与治安官部门的过往，并提到了2019年那次被录音的遭遇以及当时的感受。

sentences.en: To have this happen just a year later with their brother.
sentences.zh: 仅仅一年后，同样的事情就发生在他们的哥哥身上。

sentences.en: It shows, like on one hand, it shows how much things haven't changed.
sentences.zh: 这表明，一方面，这说明事情并没有发生多大改变。

sentences.en: And I mean, I see, like, the things changing now that he has been murdered.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我看到，在他被谋杀后，事情正在发生变化。

sentences.en: But it was like, the fact that it was allowed to happen, that it was allowed to get up to that point, shows that in 2020, how much things haven't changed.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，这种事被允许发生，被允许发展到那种地步，说明在2020年，事情并没有发生多大改变。

sentences.en: Kim, I'm really interested in the question of culpability here, especially now that King is on trial.
sentences.zh: 金，我对这里的罪责问题很感兴趣，尤其是现在金正在受审。

sentences.en: This is a rookie officer, trained by Derek Chauvin, and really, in a way, by Derek Chauvin alone.
sentences.zh: 这是一名由德里克·肖万训练的新手警官，实际上，在某种程度上，是由德里克·肖万独自训练的。

sentences.en: And three days into the job, he ends up in a situation in which his training officer is kneeling on the neck of a man over a petty alleged infraction.
sentences.zh: 入职三天，他就陷入了这样一种境地：他的训练警官正跪在一个因轻微违规嫌疑而被捕的人的脖子上。

sentences.en: He doesn't intervene.
sentences.zh: 他没有进行干预。

sentences.en: In fact, he helps to hold George Floyd down.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他还帮忙按住了乔治·弗洛伊德。

sentences.en: And, of course, Floyd dies as a direct result.
sentences.zh: 当然，弗洛伊德的死是直接结果。

sentences.en: What do you make of all those combination of factors?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待所有这些因素的结合？

sentences.en: I mean, I think that that's what the federal jury is going to be wrestling with and be deciding.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这就是联邦陪审团将要纠结和决定的问题。

sentences.en: And if you look at what's happening in the courtroom and what's happened so far, everything we've talked about today is pretty much what's played out in the trial so far.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看法庭上正在发生的事情以及到目前为止发生的一切，我们今天讨论的所有内容几乎就是审判中已经呈现出来的东西。

sentences.en: You've got the prosecution arguing that these young officers should have known better, that they were trained in the academy to speak up, to say that what's happening is not right,
sentences.zh: 控方认为这些年轻警官本应更清楚，他们在学院里受过训练，要敢于发声，要说出正在发生的事情是不对的，

sentences.en: to do something.
sentences.zh: 要做点什么。

sentences.en: And then you have the defense saying, that's not where the real training happened.
sentences.zh: 而辩方则说，真正的训练并不是在那儿发生的。

sentences.en: The real training happened under the FTO, and the FTO was Derek Chauvin.
sentences.zh: 真正的训练是在现场训练官（FTO）指导下进行的，而那个现场训练官就是德里克·肖万。

sentences.en: So they're going to be wrestling with that.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会纠结于这一点。

sentences.en: And I think it goes to the whole idea that if you watch this video, for many people, it seems very cut and dried.
sentences.zh: 我认为这归结于一个整体观念，即如果你看这段视频，对许多人来说，事情似乎非常简单明了。

sentences.en: And I think it's very easy in the inclination of most people to say, all of these officers bear some culpability for this.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为大多数人很容易倾向于认为，所有这些警官都对此负有某种责任。

sentences.en: They seem complicit.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来是同谋。

sentences.en: And the jury is going to have to decide to balance these ideas and decide what sort of level of culpability that there is.
sentences.zh: 陪审团将不得不决定如何权衡这些观点，并确定他们负有何种程度的罪责。

sentences.en: But I think that it's just more complicated than you initially think when you watch that video.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这比你最初看那段视频时想的要复杂得多。

sentences.en: When you know the backstory and you know that this man, Derek Chauvin, for King, this man held his career in the palm of his hand just a week before.
sentences.zh: 当你了解背景故事，知道德里克·肖万这个人，对于金来说，就在一周前，这个人还掌握着他的职业生涯。

sentences.en: And that makes things a little bit more complicated.
sentences.zh: 这让事情变得稍微复杂了一些。

sentences.en: And the jury is going to have to sort through all of that.
sentences.zh: 陪审团将不得不理清所有这些。

sentences.en: You know, ultimately, King's background, of course, is not what's on trial here.
sentences.zh: 你知道，归根结底，金的背景当然不是这里审判的内容。

sentences.en: His identity as a black man who joined the police force in the hope of changing it from within.
sentences.zh: 他作为一个黑人的身份，怀着从内部改变警察队伍的希望加入了警队。

sentences.en: But even so, Kim, it too is part of what feels very complicated about this story.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，金，这也是这个故事中让人感到非常复杂的一部分。

sentences.en: That someone who had wanted to make a difference, whose family and friends warned him that he couldn't change policing and that policing would instead change him.
sentences.zh: 一个曾经想做出改变的人，他的家人和朋友警告过他，他无法改变警务工作，而警务工作反而会改变他。

sentences.en: That just three days into the job, that prediction turned out to be even more true, more harrowingly true than perhaps anyone could have ever imagined.
sentences.zh: 仅仅入职三天，那个预言就变得比任何人想象的都要真实，甚至令人痛苦地真实。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's certainly not on trial here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这当然不是这里审判的内容。

sentences.en: It's just very, very sad.
sentences.zh: 这只是非常、非常悲哀。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 解释一下。

sentences.en: It's just very sad.
sentences.zh: 这只是非常悲哀。

sentences.en: It's just sad.
sentences.zh: 这只是悲哀。

sentences.en: And it doesn't play into these charges.
sentences.zh: 而且这与这些指控无关。

sentences.en: It doesn't play into what's going to happen to Alex King.
sentences.zh: 这与亚历克斯·金将会发生什么无关。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Well, it suggests that the people around Alex understood something about policing that he didn't or couldn't.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这表明亚历克斯周围的人理解一些他没有理解或无法理解的警务工作。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想那是对的。

sentences.en: I think that he was very much an optimist, very much a person who was like, sure, I can do this.
sentences.zh: 我认为他非常乐观，非常像那种会说“当然，我能做到”的人。

sentences.en: I can change policing from the inside.
sentences.zh: 我可以从内部改变警务工作。

sentences.en: But how many people have told themselves that over the last 50 years?
sentences.zh: 但在过去50年里，有多少人对自己说过这样的话？

sentences.en: How many people have been like, I'm going to be the one to stand up and I'm going to change things from the inside?
sentences.zh: 有多少人曾想过，我要成为那个站出来的人，我要从内部改变现状？

sentences.en: I mean, in any institution, it's quite difficult to do that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在任何机构中，这都相当困难。

sentences.en: And his friends certainly were more cognizant of that and his siblings.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友和兄弟姐妹当然更清楚这一点。

sentences.en: But I don't think anybody, I mean, nobody would have foreseen this happening so quickly on the job.
sentences.zh: 但我不认为任何人，我的意思是，没有人会预见到这种事在工作中发生得如此之快。

sentences.en: Something so terribly tragic.
sentences.zh: 如此极其悲惨的事情。

sentences.en: Oh, Kim.
sentences.zh: 哦，金。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: The federal trial of the three other officers involved in George Floyd's murder continues this week.
sentences.zh: 涉及乔治·弗洛伊德谋杀案的其他三名警官的联邦审判将于本周继续进行。

sentences.en: They face charges of willfully failing to intervene against Chauvin or to help Floyd.
sentences.zh: 他们面临故意不干预肖万或不帮助弗洛伊德的指控。

sentences.en: All three are also facing charges in state court of aiding and abetting murder in a trial scheduled for June.
sentences.zh: 这三人还在州法院面临协助和教唆谋杀的指控，审判定于六月进行。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，美国

sentences.en: death toll from COVID-19 surpassed 900,000,
sentences.zh: 新冠肺炎死亡人数超过了90万，

sentences.en: fueled by the highly contagious Omicron variant and the ongoing unwillingness of many Americans to vaccinate themselves against the virus.
sentences.zh: 这是由高传染性的奥密克戎变异株以及许多美国人持续不愿接种疫苗所导致的。

sentences.en: The grim milestone came as the overall direction of the pandemic improves.
sentences.zh: 这一严峻的里程碑是在大流行整体趋势好转的情况下出现的。

sentences.en: New infections in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国的新增感染人数

sentences.en: are plummeting, having fallen by more than half since mid-January.
sentences.zh: 正在急剧下降，自1月中旬以来已经减少了一半以上。

sentences.en: And U.S.
sentences.zh: 此外，美国

sentences.en: officials have told Congress that a Russian invasion of Ukraine could result in the death of as many as 50,000 civilians and 35,000 soldiers,
sentences.zh: 官员告诉国会，俄罗斯入侵乌克兰可能导致多达5万名平民和3.5万名士兵死亡，

sentences.en: and could trigger a refugee crisis that could send more than 1 million people fleeing into Europe.
sentences.zh: 并可能引发一场难民危机，导致超过100万人逃往欧洲。

sentences.en: The officials believe that Russia would wait until later this month to act and say the country has assembled 70% of the military forces it would need to pull off a full-scale invasion.
sentences.zh: 官员们认为，俄罗斯会等到本月晚些时候再采取行动，并称该国已经集结了全面入侵所需军事力量的70%。
